questions.questionText:

but none of them responded.

questions.questionText:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in
the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A)Human relationships are a matter of great concern for every one of us.
B)Nevertheless, social scientists have attached many other elements that actually help
us for a good social life.
C)As it helps us all to have a coordinated, balanced and approachable life.
D)The present generation fails to take cognisance of all such elements and fall prey to
a lonely life risking happiness.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (D).
